assumptions: 'A 100 A band' is taken as the FWHM of the intensity spectrum (10 nm), a Gaussian pulse with 165 fs transform limit; its group-delay dispersion is set so that the pulse is 5.8 ps long (3.46e5 fs^2).
The pair is traversed once (gratingPair passes = 1): Treacy's geometry has the light go through the two gratings one time. The engine's default is passes = 2 (double-passed compressor).
separationM is the perpendicular distance G, b = G / cos(theta_d) (theta_d the diffraction angle, equal to gamma - theta of eq. (3)).
Finite grating size, resolving power and efficiency (p. 457) are not modelled.
